phrases.phrase: A member can't send a new request until this many days after their last approved change. 0 turns it off.
Field id of a custom user field for the department or cell. Leave blank if there isn't one; the department can still go into the rank line through the format below.
Field id of the custom user field holding the faction key (led, fdc, gom, motb, vortex...). Faction leaders are matched to requests through this field.
Field id of the custom user field holding the in-game name. Leave blank to not write it.
Field id of the custom user field shown as the rank line of the player box. Leave blank to not write it.

One faction per line: key|label|faction user group id|rank titles R0 to R7, comma separated. The key must match the choice key of the faction profile field. On approval the member is removed from every faction group listed here and added to the new one. Use 0 to leave groups alone for a faction.
What is written to the rank field. Placeholders: {title} (e.g. Detective), {rank} (0-7), {department}, {faction}. Examples: {title} or {title} · {department}.
Factions, profile fields and rules for the faction change form.
Approve requests to join own faction (faction leaders)
